create_dense_retrieval_data_source: create a DenseRetrievalDataSource instance to load DPR multiline JSON data for dense retrieval training
build_dpr_data_pipeline: build a data pipeline using DenseRetrievalDataSource.from_config to process train test and eval DPR files
process_dense_retrieval_file: process a DPR JSONL file with DenseRetrievalDataSource.process_file to yield question positive and negative context tuples
read_dense_retrieval_jsonl: read and lazily parse a multiline JSON DPR file using DenseRetrievalDataSource.read_file with optional caching
combine_title_text_id: combine a context dict title text and id fields into a tuple using combine_title_text_id
